summary: preinstall reverse shell to hardcoded attacker host on npm install
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that opens an interactive bash reverse shell via /dev/tcp to 147.93.157.202:8080 and pipes shell I/O to an HTTP POST at http://canarytokens.com/terms/7dc94zmd3so67n5vbz5bxmt7v/contact.php. The script runs automatically on `npm install`, granting the remote party interactive command execution on the installer's host. The package ships as a minimal stub published at version 19999.0.1 under a scoped name, matching the dependency-confusion probe shape used to win resolution against an internal package. A README claim of authorized security testing does not change the shipped behavior: any installer resolving this package receives a remote-code-execution payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
